user.description: Arming code (optional), delays, and the spoken deterrent. You'll pick sensors and outputs next.

data.exit_delay: Exit delay (time to leave after arming)
data.entry_delay: Entry delay (grace period before the full alarm sounds)

sensors.title: Vigil — sensors
sensors.description: Leave both 'all' toggles on and you don't need to pick anything — Vigil watches every motion/occupancy sensor and uses every outdoor person sensor automatically. Turn a toggle off only if you want to hand-pick from the (pre-filled) list below it. Per-mode exclusions remove specific sensors from one mode (e.g. Home ignores the lounge). Approach sensors never trigger the alarm — they boost indoor movement seen around the same time.

data.monitored_sensors: …or hand-pick monitored sensors (only used if the toggle above is off)
data.approach_all_person: Use ALL outdoor person-detection sensors as approach
data.approach_sensors: …or hand-pick approach sensors (only used if the toggle above is off)
data.excluded_global: NEVER monitor these (all modes) — e.g. an outdoor motion sensor
data.excluded_away: Away — exclude these sensors (leave empty = watch all)
data.excluded_home: Home — exclude these sensors (leave empty = watch all)
data.excluded_night: Night — exclude these sensors (leave empty = watch all)
data.excluded_vacation: Vacation — exclude these sensors (leave empty = watch all)
